entries.name: Acne
entries.mappingCaution: Classical description overlaps with acne but is not a validated diagnostic equivalent.
entries.standardCare: Gentle skin care and evidence-based topical treatment; seek dermatology care for scarring or persistent inflammatory acne.

entries.name: Painful urination
entries.mappingCaution: Painful urination has multiple causes and is not synonymous with urinary infection.
entries.standardCare: Clinical assessment and urine testing when indicated; antibiotics for bacterial infection when prescribed.

entries.name: Hair loss
entries.mappingCaution: Classical hair loss categories do not establish the modern cause.
entries.standardCare: Assess pattern, medications, scalp disease and nutritional or endocrine causes as indicated.
redFlags: Rapid patchy or scarring hair loss
